final: WITH major_groups AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), stats AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members, COUNT(*) as num_groups, SUM(member_count) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_per_group FROM major_groups) SELECT mg.link_to_major, mg.member_count, mg.member_count * 1.0 / stats.total_members as fraction_of_total, mg.member_count * 1.0 / stats.avg_per_group as ratio_to_average FROM major_groups mg CROSS JOIN stats ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
